name: AI Pathfinder North Ayrshire / Irvine i3 AI data centre
notes: Announced as a £15bn North Ayrshire site in the i3 area of Irvine, with 1GW initial capacity and possible 1.5GW expansion. Later APRS/Bloomberg summary reports no planning application or PAN and corporate/legal uncertainty, so current delivery risk is high.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Hunterston Data Centre Campus
developer: Eneus Energy; Revera Energy; Hunterston Estate
notes: Developer describes an early-stage proposed data centre campus at Hunterston, North Ayrshire, advanced through planning/environmental assessment and public consultation. APRS cites EIA scoping submission 26/00138/EIA in February 2026; no firm MW disclosed by developer.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Apatura Ravenscraig Data Centre Campus
notes: Proposed 550MW data centre campus within the Ravenscraig masterplan area, paired with a 150MW BESS per Apatura consultation materials; DCD reports £3.9bn investment and possible 2030 online timing.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Apatura Drumshangie / Plains Data Centre
notes: APRS identifies a 500MW pre-planning proposal at Drumshangie moss/former coal mine near Greengairs/Airdrie with PAN reference 26/00069/PAN. Treated as planned because public planning-stage information exists, though source is advocacy/aggregator rather than developer.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Aurelius Data Centre Project / North Lanrigg
notes: ILI consultation site describes an AI-focused hyper data centre at North Lanrigg, Carlisle Road, Motherwell/Cleland. Third-party profile cites North Lanarkshire PAN 25/00989/PAN and 400MW target; ILI lists Aurelius as one of its Stoics green digital network sites.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Lanarkshire AI Growth Zone - South Lanridge / Chapelhall
developer: HFD Renewables NL / DataVita; CoreWeave named in reporting
notes: DataVita describes the UK Government AI Growth Zone in North Lanarkshire as including 500MW of data centre capacity and over £8.2bn investment. North Lanarkshire planning portal records PAN 25/01328/PAN for South Lanridge Farm; Guardian reporting says CoreWeave is involved and questions renewable-power claims.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: DataVita Fortis / Chapelhall expansion
notes: APRS records Planning Permission in Principle application 25/01159/PPP approved 9 January 2026 for a Chapelhall/Fortis extension to 40MW. Data center directories describe DataVita Fortis/DV1 at Chapelhall and a proposed adjacent DV3 expansion.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Microsoft Project Natick Phase 2 / Northern Isles underwater datacenter
notes: Microsoft deployed the 12-rack, 864-server Northern Isles underwater datacenter at EMEC in Orkney in June 2018 and retrieved it after about two years. DCD reported in June 2024 that Microsoft confirmed Project Natick is no longer active; 0.24MW is widely reported for the pod but not in the primary Microsoft page.

name: Alchemy Plus Lerwick data processing and storage centre
notes: 2010 public reports said Shetland Islands Council signed an MoU with Alchemy Plus for a £12m, 1,200 sqm Lerwick data centre; later reporting said the developer had gone back to the drawing board. A 2014 Orkney energy audit referenced a 4MW Alchemy Plus Data Centre in Shetland. No reliable evidence found that the project became operational.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Apatura Haspielaw / Hamilton hyperscale data centre
notes: APRS identifies a hyperscale data centre proposal on green belt farmland southwest of Hamilton/Haspielaw, developer Apatura, with EIA required and capacity not disclosed in planning documents.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Coalburn 2 Data Centre and Green Energy Opportunity
notes: NovaLoca listing and Alcemi EIA documents state South Lanarkshire Council granted planning permission in principle in May 2020 for a c.400,000 sq ft two-level data centre with 12MW solar farm and 7.5MW gas turbine under P/19/0896. Earlier PAN documents describe a 75MW data centre; later Alcemi material notes a reduced-scale hydrogen development may overlap/mutually exclude the data-centre scheme.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Asanti Hamilton Data Centre
notes: Operational regional colocation/disaster-recovery facility at Asanti House, 4 Lister Way, Hamilton International Technology Park, Blantyre. Public directories list 5,000 sq ft of whitespace; Asanti acquired the site from Daisy Group in 2022.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Apatura Plean AI Data Centre Campus
notes: Apatura submitted a Proposal of Application Notice to Stirling and Falkirk councils for a 43.1 ha Plean/Torwood AI data centre campus with 300MW utility capacity. DCD later reported Apatura changed location to Larbert, three miles from Plean; coded rejected to indicate the Stirling/Plean site did not proceed as the active site.
